items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta and Edward "Kid" Ory Interview, 1958-08-26
items.q: The name 'Bruce' is mentioned by the interviewer as a nickname for 'Babette', but the interviewee does not respond to or acknowledge this name in the provided context.

ctx.x: Tell me your name. Tell me your name. Tell me your name. Tell me your name. Tell me your name.
Wait. Tell me. Tell me that. That's Mike. Come on. We call her Bruce for short, but her name is Babette. What is your name? She's a little girl. She's no... Sir Dice, huh? She no address. She does.
